tasks.name: more-itertools-windowed-strict
tasks.kind: well-specified change in a mature repository
tasks.prompt: In this repo (more-itertools), add a `strict` keyword argument to `windowed()`, defaulting to False. With `strict=True`, `windowed` must never yield a window that would need `fillvalue` padding: when it reaches such a window it raises ValueError instead, the way `zip(strict=True)` does, and the complete windows before it are still yielded. With `strict=False` nothing changes. Update the type stub and the docstring, and add tests. The test suite runs with `python3 -m unittest -q`.
